registration.updates_basis: TRAIN-only 256-update profiles (seed 0): max conservative x2 per-fit projection at 20000 updates 862.9 s (IQL) <= 3600 s member cap; x2 nine-fit projection 4925.0 s <= 10800 s family cap. Ceiling 20000 used. Resource-only; no quality metric read.

fixed_training.sampler: uniform over retained transitions, numpy default_rng(seed)

registration.primary_family: DEV control world joint four: IQL/planner(P2), CQL/planner(P2), IQL/NNBC, CQL/NNBC

decision_rule.p_value: max(imputed one-sided p, worst-case one-sided p); Holm across the four
decision_rule.preliminary_screen: mean imputed dWE >= 0.0001 per PA, paired whole-game bootstrap CI lower > 0
decision_rule.strong_model_internal: additionally worst-case truncation mean lower bound > 0 and worst-case game-bootstrap CI lower > 0
decision_rule.broad_rl_gain: a method must pass both its planner and matched-NNBC comparisons
decision_rule.inference_minimum: 30 games and 50 supported PA starts, else descriptive only
decision_rule.seed_aggregation: equal-probability ensemble of three seed policies (CQL: mixture of seed-greedy one-hot); individual seeds descriptive

registration.candidate_world: sensitivity only; not a second success family
